caption: A hot-air popcorn machine is switched on, and popped kernels burst out of the chute into a bowl.

sa.check: A hot-air popcorn machine stands with its chute over a bowl.
Popped kernels come out of the chute.
The popped pieces fall into the bowl.
The flow stops when the machine is switched off.
Nothing comes out before the machine is switched on.

pc.expect: The pieces only come out while the machine runs and the bowl only fills; the flow stops when it is switched off.
pc.fail: Pieces come out before the machine is switched on; or the bowl empties while the machine still runs; or the flow stops and starts again with the switch untouched; or pieces travel back up the chute into the machine.

pc.expect: Each piece that leaves the chute is a large irregular white puff rather than a small hard grain, and unpopped kernels stay small and dark.
pc.fail: Small hard kernels are blown out as if popped; or a popped piece turns back into a smooth yellow kernel; or a piece swells gradually like a balloon rather than bursting; or the pieces come out as one continuous mass.

pc.expect: The popcorn in the bowl came out of the chute and none appears from nowhere.
pc.fail: Pieces appear in the bowl with none leaving the chute; or the pile in the bowl shrinks while pieces keep arriving; or a piece vanishes in mid-air; or a second chute appears.

pc.expect: The pieces leave the chute, arc downward and land in the bowl or around it; they do not rise.
pc.fail: The pieces rise from the chute and stay aloft; or hang in the air between chute and bowl; or fall upward out of the bowl; or the pile gathers on the machine's top.

pc.expect: One machine with one chute and one bowl; the pieces pass through the chute's mouth and nothing passes through the machine's shell or the bowl.
pc.fail: A piece passes out through the machine's shell; or a piece passes through the bowl's wall; or the chute passes into the bowl; or the machine changes shape.

pc.expect: The machine's body, the bowl and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The machine changes colour; or the bowl changes pattern; or items on the counter rearrange.
